Here's a summary of our return policy for recent orders:

**Return Windows (from delivery date):**
- **Electronics:** 15 days
- **Clothing, Kitchen & Accessories:** 30 days
- **Books:** 14 days

**Extended Windows:**
- **Gold or Platinum members** get an extra 15 days added to the standard window.
- **Prime shipping members** get an additional 15 days on top of that.
- **Holiday orders** (placed in November or December) can be returned through January 31 of the following year, if that gives you more time than the membership extensions.
- **Store-credit grace period:** If you're up to 15 days past your return window, you can still return the item for store credit (rather than a refund to your original payment method).

**Defective, Wrong, or Damaged Items:**
- No time restriction — these can be returned at any time.
- You'll receive a full refund and free return shipping.

**Restocking Fees (opened electronics, change-of-mind returns only):**
- 15% restocking fee on opened electronics.
- **Platinum members:** Fee fully waived.
- **Gold members:** 50% off the fee.
- **Silver members:** 25% off the fee.

**Return Shipping:**
- **Orders $50 or more:** Free return shipping label provided.
- **Orders under $50:** $8 return shipping fee (deducted from your refund).
- **Defective/wrong/damaged items:** Always free return shipping, regardless of order value.

**Refunds:**
- Refunds go back to your original payment method when returned within the standard window.
- Returns during the store-credit grace period are issued as store credit.
- If a promo or coupon was used, the discount is allocated proportionally — so the refund reflects the actual amount you paid for that item.

---

If you'd like to start a return on a specific order, just share your **customer ID** and **order ID** and I'll look into it right away!
